## Class Info

- **Class size:** 8 students  
- **Activity duration:** ~40–50 minutes total (3 rounds + debrief)

## Core Materials

| Item | Quantity | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Large bowl (lake) | 1 | Holds shared “fish” population. |
| Small cups (boats) | 8 | One per student. |
| Tokens (“fish”: candies/beans/beads) | 40–50 | Start each round with **30** in the bowl; extras cover loss/spills. |
| Scratch paper / notecards | 8 | Students record private decisions. |
| Pens/pencils | 8 | For decisions + reflections. |
| Printed student handouts | 32 | 4 per student: Round 1, Round 2, Round 3, Final Debrief. |
| Instructor master copy | 1 | To track counts and timings. |

## Optional Visualization / Tools

| Item | Quantity | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Whiteboard or notepad | 1 | Show totals & reproduction each round. |
| Dry-erase markers | 2–3 | Differentiate catch vs. reproduction. |
| Calculator (or phone) | 1 | Quick doubling checks. |

## Suggested “Fish” Tokens

| Type | Pros | Cons |
|---|---|---|
| Small candies (Skittles/M&Ms) | Engaging; edible reward afterward. | Tempting; bring extras. |
| Dried beans/pasta | Cheap; reusable; low distraction. | Less colorful. |
| Plastic tokens/beads | Durable; easy to count/store. | Requires storage afterward. |

## Quick Setup Notes

1. **Pre-class:** Count **30 fish** into the bowl; place 8 boats; keep extra tokens handy.  
2. **Round flow:**  
   - **R1 (Open Access):** No discussion. Start with 30.  
   - **R2 (Fixed Quota):** Reset to 30; allow **2 min** to agree on a class quota.  
   - **R3 (Fixed Effort):** Reset to 30; allow **2 min** to agree on a per-person limit.  
3. **Between rounds:** Count remaining fish, **double** (cap at 30). Record on board.  
4. **End:** Collect all four student sheets for participation credit; distribute candies if desired.
